from pathlib import Path
src = Path('/inputs/report.html')
dst = Path('/work/report.html')
data = src.read_bytes()
needle = b'</head>'
if data.count(needle) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError(f'Expected exactly one {needle!r}, found {data.count(needle)}')
insertion = (b'<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).">\n'
             b'<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n')
pos = data.index(needle)
out = data[:pos] + insertion + data[pos:]
out.decode('utf-8')
dst.write_bytes(out)
print('wrote', dst, 'bytes', len(out), 'inserted_bytes', len(insertion), 'at', pos)

from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
src = Path('/inputs/report.html').read_bytes()
out = Path('/work/report.html').read_bytes()
needle = b'</head>'
inserted = (b'<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).">\n'
            b'<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n')
pos = src.index(needle)
assert out == src[:pos] + inserted + src[pos:]
assert out[:pos] == src[:pos] and out[pos+len(inserted):] == src[pos:]
text = out.decode('utf-8')

class Audit(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.metas=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'meta': self.metas.append(attrs)
    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'meta': self.metas.append(attrs)

a=Audit(); a.feed(text); a.close()

assert targets[0] == [('name','description'), ('content','AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview).')], targets[0]
